prompt:
超写实室内暗黑时尚人像摄影，竖版约 3:4，一名明确成年的东亚女性，20+，坐在黑色皮质沙发扶手与坐垫交界处，身体正面略微朝画面左侧，上半身保持直立，双腿形成非常明显的高位交叉姿势。摄影者位于人物正前方约 1.5–2 米，采用 50–70mm 等效镜头，机位接近人物腰腹高度，人物从头顶完整拍到小腿和长靴，主体几乎占满画面。

人物为中小骨架、自然沙漏型身材，肩膀偏窄，胸部自然丰满，腰部明显纤细，髋部圆润，大腿具有柔软真实体积，小腿修长。整体曲线明显但保持真实，不要健美肌肉、极端宽胯、夸张巨臀或纸片人比例。

姿势是画面重点：人物坐在黑色沙发右侧，一条腿作为支撑腿自然向下，另一条腿高高抬起并横跨在前方，膝盖靠近胸腹高度，大腿几乎横向贯穿画面中央，形成强烈近景层次；交叉腿的膝盖与大腿距离镜头最近，因此略有自然透视放大。上半身保持稳定，不要明显后仰。

人物留乌黑色超长直发＋厚重齐刘海，刘海整齐覆盖额头并接近眉毛，左右发丝贴着脸颊，右侧长发自然垂到胸口以下。发质顺滑、黑亮，整体带冷艳哥特感。

脸型小巧偏鹅蛋形，下颌柔和，肤色非常白皙偏冷。眼睛为浅灰蓝 / 冰蓝色，眼线细长，睫毛浓密但不过度夸张，眼妆以黑灰、烟熏棕为主。双眼正视镜头，表情冷静、疏离、略带压迫感。鼻梁细直，嘴唇为低饱和裸粉豆沙色，嘴巴自然闭合。

颈部佩戴黑色圆珠短项链＋细银链叠戴，中央有小型月牙或细小金属吊坠。配饰整体为黑色珠链、银色细链和少量水钻，不要大型彩色宝石。

人物穿一件黑色哥特风紧身束身连体衣 / corset bodysuit。上半身为黑色结构化罩杯与半透明黑色网纱拼接，胸口沿线装饰大量黑色圆珠、银色链条、水钻、小吊坠和细小金属挂饰。罩杯边缘有明显黑色珠链滚边，胸前和腰腹之间有多条垂坠珠链和细链。

腰腹区域采用黑色半透明薄纱＋纵向束骨结构，能看到多条黑色竖向骨线，整体紧贴腰部，强化细腰。侧腰为高开叉结构，露出部分髋骨与侧腰皮肤，但服装保持完整覆盖。下身与上衣连接成一体，整体为黑色高叉舞台内搭 / 连体衣设计。

双腿基本裸露，不穿丝袜。脚穿一双非常醒目的黑色亮面皮革及膝长靴 / knee-high boots，靴筒贴合小腿，长度到膝盖下方，材质为高光黑色皮革或漆皮，鞋头略尖或偏窄，鞋跟为中高跟细跟或窄跟。交叉在前方的那条腿靴筒占据画面下半部中央，形成强烈黑色纵向视觉线。

人物坐在黑色真皮沙发 / 黑色皮革扶手椅上，沙发表面有明显柔和反光和褶皱，坐垫与扶手被身体压出轻微凹陷。

背景是一整面深灰黑色木质展示柜 / 嵌入式书架，由多个矩形格子组成。柜体为深灰、炭黑、黑褐色木纹，内部摆放少量透明高脚杯、小型玻璃酒杯、金属装饰、黑色花瓶和极少量摆件，整体非常克制，不要堆满物品。背景保持清楚但明显比人物暗。

光线采用正面相机直闪＋暗室环境光。闪光灯直接打亮人物脸部、肩颈、胸口、裸露大腿和黑色服装上的珠链金属装饰，皮肤呈冷白瓷感；黑色束身衣、珠链和皮靴出现明显高光反射。背景迅速压暗，形成强烈人物与环境分离。

整体呈 2000s–2010s 暗黑时尚 / 哥特 Cosplay 写真＋便携数码相机直闪质感：人物清晰，黑色服装细节丰富，皮肤略带闪光高光，暗部较深，少量颗粒和 JPEG 压缩感，不要现代 HDR 或电影级布光。

重点锁定：成年东亚女性＋超长黑直发＋厚齐刘海＋冰蓝灰眼睛＋黑色珠链项圈＋黑色半透明束身连体衣＋罩杯边缘大量黑珠、水钻、银链和垂坠饰品＋网纱束骨腰封＋黑色及膝亮面长靴＋黑色皮沙发＋坐姿＋一条腿高高横跨交叉在前方＋膝盖靠近胸腹＋深灰黑展示柜背景＋正面直闪＋冷白肤色＋暗黑哥特时尚写真。

避免：长卷发、短发、无刘海、彩色服装、红色内衣、普通连衣裙、运动装、丝袜、网袜、白靴、运动鞋、双腿普通并排、站姿、躺姿、夸张巨臀、健美肌肉、暖黄肤色、明亮白色客厅、户外背景、强背景虚化、电影柔光、动漫脸、CG 感、塑料皮肤、多余肢体、水印和乱码文字。

promptTranslations.en:
Ultra-realistic indoor dark fashion portrait photography, vertical orientation approximately 3:4, an explicitly adult East Asian woman in her 20s+, sitting at the junction of the armrest and seat cushion of a black leather sofa, her body facing slightly toward the left side of the frame, upper body held upright, legs positioned in a very pronounced high crossed-leg pose. The photographer is located directly in front of the subject about 1.5–2 meters away, using a 50–70mm equivalent lens, with the camera height close to the subject's waist and abdomen, capturing the subject completely from the top of the head to the calves and boots, with the main subject almost filling the frame.

The subject has a small-to-medium bone structure, a natural hourglass figure, relatively narrow shoulders, naturally full breasts, a distinctly slender waist, rounded hips, thighs with soft realistic volume, and slender calves. The overall curves are pronounced yet kept realistic; no bodybuilder muscles, extreme wide hips, exaggerated giant buttocks, or paper-thin proportions.

The pose is the focal point of the image: the subject sits on the right side of the black sofa, one leg naturally extending downward as a supporting leg, while the other leg is raised high and crossed over in front, with the knee close to chest and abdomen height, the thigh almost horizontally spanning the center of the frame, creating a strong foreground depth; the knee and thigh of the crossed leg are closest to the lens, thus showing a slight natural perspective enlargement. The upper body remains stable, without leaning back noticeably.

The subject has jet-black ultra-long straight hair + thick straight-cut blunt bangs, with the bangs neatly covering the forehead and close to the eyebrows, hair strands on the left and right hugging the cheeks, and the long hair on the right falling naturally below the chest. The hair texture is sleek, glossy black, overall conveying a cold, glamorous gothic feel.

The face shape is petite and oval-leaning, with a soft jawline, and a very fair, cool-toned porcelain complexion. Eyes are pale grey-blue / icy blue, with slender eyeliner, thick but not overly exaggerated eyelashes, and eye makeup dominated by black-grey and smoky brown tones. Eyes look directly into the camera, with a calm, aloof, slightly imposing expression. The bridge of the nose is slender and straight, and the lips are a low-saturation nude-pink bean-paste shade, with the mouth naturally closed.

Wearing a layered short black beaded choker necklace + thin silver chain around the neck, with a small crescent moon or delicate metal pendant in the center. The accessories are entirely black beaded chains, fine silver chains, and a few rhinestones, avoiding large colored gemstones.

The subject wears a black gothic-style tight-fitting corset bodysuit. The upper part is a patchwork of black structured cups and semi-sheer black mesh, with the neckline along the cups decorated with a profusion of black beads, silver chains, rhinestones, small pendants, and delicate metal charms. The cup edges have distinct black bead chain piping, and multiple draped bead chains and delicate chains hang between the chest and abdomen.

The waist and abdomen area uses black semi-sheer mesh + vertical boned corset structure, showing multiple black vertical boning lines, hugging the waist tightly overall to accentuate the slender waist. The sides feature a high-cut structure, revealing parts of the hip bones and side waist skin, yet the outfit remains fully covered. The lower half connects seamlessly with the top, designed overall as a black high-cut stage bodysuit / leotard.

Legs are mostly bare, without stockings or tights. On the feet are a very eye-catching pair of glossy black leather knee-high boots, the boot shafts fitting the calves snugly, reaching just below the knees, made of high-shine black leather or patent leather, with slightly pointed or narrow toes, and medium-to-high stiletto or slender heels. The boot of the crossed leg in front occupies the lower-middle part of the frame, forming a strong black vertical visual line.

The subject sits on a black genuine leather sofa / black leather armchair, the leather surface displaying soft highlights and natural creases, with the cushion and armrest slightly indented under the weight of her body.

The background is a full wall of deep charcoal-black wooden display cabinets / built-in bookshelves consisting of multiple rectangular compartments. The cabinet frame is deep grey, charcoal black, and dark brown wood grain, sparsely displaying a few transparent wine glasses, small glass tumblers, metal decorations, a black vase, and minimal ornaments; the overall display is very restrained, not cluttered with items. The background remains sharp but noticeably darker than the subject.

Lighting uses direct on-camera flash + dark ambient room light. The flash directly illuminates the subject's face, neck, chest, exposed thighs, and the beaded metal decorations on the black outfit, giving the skin a cool white porcelain feel; the black corset, bead chains, and leather boots show distinct specular reflections. The background falls off quickly into darkness, creating a stark separation between the subject and the environment.

Overall style evokes a 2000s–2010s dark fashion / gothic cosplay photoshoot + point-and-shoot digital camera direct-flash aesthetic: clear subject, rich details in the black clothing, slight flash glare on the skin, deep shadows, subtle grain and JPEG compression artifacts, without modern HDR or cinematic lighting setups.

Key focus points: adult East Asian woman + ultra-long straight black hair + thick blunt bangs + icy blue-grey eyes + black beaded choker + black semi-sheer corset bodysuit + cup trim with abundant black beads, rhinestones, silver chains, and draped ornaments + mesh boned waist corset + black glossy knee-high boots + black leather sofa + sitting pose + one leg raised high and crossed horizontally in front + knee near chest and abdomen + charcoal-black display shelf background + direct frontal flash + cool white skin tone + dark gothic fashion photography.

Avoid: long curly hair, short hair, no bangs, colorful clothing, red lingerie, plain dresses, athletic wear, stockings, fishnets, white boots, sneakers, legs normally side by side, standing pose, lying down, exaggerated giant buttocks, bodybuilder muscles, warm yellow skin tone, bright white living room, outdoor background, heavy background blur, cinematic soft lighting, anime face, CG look, plastic skin, extra limbs, watermarks, and gibberish text.

summaryTranslations.en: Dark gothic fashion portrait of an East Asian woman in a corset bodysuit and patent leather knee-high boots sitting on a leather sofa, shot with direct frontal flash.

腰腹区域采用黑色半透明薄纱＋纵向束骨结构，能看到多条黑色竖向骨线，整体紧贴腰部，强化细腰。侧腰为高开叉结构，露出部分髋骨与侧腰皮肤，但服装保持完整覆盖。下身与上衣连接成一体，整体为黑色高叉舞台内搭 / 连体衣设计。

双腿基本裸露，不穿丝袜。脚穿一双非常醒目的黑色亮面皮革及膝长靴 / knee-high boots，靴筒贴合小腿，长度到膝盖下方，材质为高光黑色皮革或漆皮，鞋头略尖或偏窄，鞋跟为中高跟细跟或窄跟。交叉在前方的那条腿靴筒占据画面下半部中央，形成强烈黑色纵向视觉线。

人物坐在黑色真皮沙发 / 黑色皮革扶手椅上，沙发表面有明显柔和反光和褶皱，坐垫与扶手被身体压出轻微凹陷。

背景是一整面深灰黑色木质展示柜 / 嵌入式书架，由多个矩形格子组成。柜体为深灰、炭黑、黑褐色木纹，内部摆放少量透明高脚杯、小型玻璃酒杯、金属装饰、黑色花瓶和极少量摆件，整体非常克制，不要堆满物品。背景保持清楚但明显比人物暗。

光线采用正面相机直闪＋暗室环境光。闪光灯直接打亮人物脸部、肩颈、胸口、裸露大腿和黑色服装上的珠链金属装饰，皮肤呈冷白瓷感；黑色束身衣、珠链和皮靴出现明显高光反射。背景迅速压暗，形成强烈人物与环境分离。

整体呈 2000s–2010s 暗黑时尚 / 哥特 Cosplay 写真＋便携数码相机直闪质感：人物清晰，黑色服装细节丰富，皮肤略带闪光高光，暗部较深，少量颗粒和 JPEG 压缩感，不要现代 HDR 或电影级布光。

重点锁定：成年东亚女性＋超长黑直发＋厚齐刘海＋冰蓝灰眼睛＋黑色珠链项圈＋黑色半透明束身连体衣＋罩杯边缘大量黑珠、水钻、银链和垂坠饰品＋网纱束骨腰封＋黑色及膝亮面长靴＋黑色皮沙发＋坐姿＋一条腿高高横跨交叉在前方＋膝盖靠近胸腹＋深灰黑展示柜背景＋正面直闪＋冷白肤色＋暗黑哥特时尚写真。

避免：长卷发、短发、无刘海、彩色服装、红色内衣、普通连衣裙、运动装、丝袜、网袜、白靴、运动鞋、双腿普通并排、站姿、躺姿、夸张巨臀、健美肌肉、暖黄肤色、明亮白色客厅、户外背景、强背景虚化、电影柔光、动漫脸、CG 感、塑料皮肤、多余肢体、水印和乱码文字。

translations.zh: 超写实暗黑哥特风格人像摄影：一名20多岁东亚女性坐在黑色皮沙发扶手上，双腿高位交叉。她留黑长直发配齐刘海，冷白肤色，佩戴珠链饰品，身穿黑色半透明束身连体衣与黑色亮面及膝长靴。背景为深色木质展示柜，正面直闪营造鲜明反差。
translations.en: Photorealistic dark gothic portrait: A 20s East Asian woman sitting on a black leather sofa armrest with legs crossed high. Featuring long straight black hair, blunt bangs, pale skin, beaded accessories, a black sheer corset bodysuit, and shiny knee-high leather boots. Dark wooden shelf background with direct on-camera flash.
